name: DemshiTelco Swakopmund Data Centre
notes: Public-participation notice and DemshiTelco LinkedIn post describe a proposed carrier-neutral Tier 3 5MW data centre at Swakopmund Mile 4/Farm 267 in Erongo Region; exact approval/construction status not confirmed.

name: IT Guru Solutions DC
notes: Data Center Platform lists IT Guru Solutions as operating one colocation data centre, IT Guru Solutions DC, at 6th Street, Walvis Bay; capacity not disclosed.

name: Paratus Armada Data Center
notes: Operator page and trade press confirm the carrier-neutral Tier III-by-design Armada facility just outside Windhoek; operator states 2MVA campus power, but MW IT load is not disclosed.

name: MTC Data Centre Ausspannplatz
notes: Datacenters.com lists MTC Data Centre Ausspannplatz in Windhoek, Khomas Region; MTC annual-report material references completion of a new data centre, but current capacity is not disclosed.

name: Telecom Namibia Datacenter
notes: DataCenterMap and Data Center Platform list Telecom Namibia Datacenter on Luderitz Street, Windhoek; operator site confirms Telecom Namibia as national ICT operator, but facility capacity is not disclosed.

name: SALT DC
notes: SALT's own business-continuity offering references data-centre hosting, and Data Center Platform lists SALT DC at 161 Mandume Ndemufayo Avenue, Windhoek; capacity not disclosed.

name: University of Namibia Datacenter
notes: Data Center Platform lists University of Namibia as having one Windhoek data centre; treated as operational institutional facility, capacity not disclosed.

name: MTN Windhoek
notes: Data Center Platform's Namibia country listing includes MTN Windhoek among mapped data centres; no capacity or further facility detail found.

name: Namibia National Data Centre
developer: Ministry of Information and Communication Technology / Office of the Prime Minister
notes: National government project identified as a 2026/27 MICT flagship under a N$639.2m ICT budget; site and capacity are not disclosed, assigned to Khomas because central-government digital infrastructure is Windhoek-led unless a separate site is announced.
